headline: Danis Folded
caption:
UPDATE: Arman Tsarukyan shut out Dillon Danis 10-0 at RAF 14, then stepped on his chest after the match.
Respect or too far? 👇

The UFC lightweight contender won the RAF middleweight crossover title in Las Vegas a day after their press conference brawl. Khamzat Chimaev also beat Robbie Lawler 10-0 on the card.

🔥 Hot take: Danis should stay out of the wrestling world.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Respect or too far?
hot_take: Danis should *stay out* of the wrestling world.
